items.title: Spiral Spinach Pie
items.alt: Coiled golden pastry pie with an open end showing dark green spinach filling on a round wooden board.
items.description: Coiled golden pastry pie with an open end showing dark green spinach filling on a round wooden board. Use the spiral shape in a food-pattern lesson or a personal savory-baking journal.

items.title: Mushroom Galette
items.alt: Rustic folded mushroom galette with sliced mushrooms and herbs beside a wooden-handled metal server.
items.description: Rustic folded mushroom galette with sliced mushrooms and herbs beside a wooden-handled metal server. This free-form savory pastry suits a classroom food card or a personal mushroom recipe cover.

items.title: Long Tomato Tart
items.alt: Long rectangular tomato tart with red and yellow slices and basil leaves in a dark fluted tin.
items.description: Long rectangular tomato tart with red and yellow slices and basil leaves in a dark fluted tin. Its long shape leaves room for copy beside a personal menu or a classroom vegetable activity.

items.title: Filled Pasty
items.alt: Folded golden pasty with a thick crimped seam and an open end showing potato, carrot and minced filling.
items.description: Folded golden pasty with a thick crimped seam and an open end showing potato, carrot and minced filling. Use the handheld savory pastry in a food vocabulary worksheet or a personal lunch layout.

items.title: Vegetable Quiche
items.alt: Deep vegetable quiche with broccoli and red pepper pieces and a cut wedge placed beside it.
items.description: Deep vegetable quiche with broccoli and red pepper pieces and a cut wedge placed beside it. The cut section suits a classroom ingredient observation task or a personal lunch-menu design.

items.title: Mini Fruit Mince Pies
items.alt: Three small mince pies with open, star-topped and vented lids on a piece of parchment.
items.description: Three small mince pies with open, star-topped and vented lids on a piece of parchment. Use these small dried-fruit pastries in a personal festive menu or a classroom counting activity.
